### Something Old
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/article-library/individual/something-old
Passage: Isaiah 40:8
Points:
- Cherishing well-preserved relics of the past connects us to history and provides perspective during modern trials.
- The Old Testament Scriptures have withstood centuries of criticism and attacks without losing their power.
- While earthly creations and human achievements fade like grass, God's word stands solid forever.
- Resting on the enduring truth of the Bible supplies believers with fresh courage, gratitude, and stamina to face the future.
